our story

Two Families, One Bond

  1. i

    The First Hello

    Every love story begins with a hello. Theirs is one Anjana and Sravan will happily tell you themselves, so do ask them on the day.

  2. ii

    Two Families, One Bond

    The Raveendran family of Puthiyaveetil House, Tholur, and the Edayapurath family of Kodakara, Thrissur, come together with the blessings of the Almighty.

  3. iii

    A New Beginning

    At the 8:00 AM Muhurtham on Sunday, 06 December 2026, the Thalikettu Ceremony at the Sreekrishna Temple, Guruvayoor, begins their life together.
